purpose: Teach: 吸収/原料/発掘/天候/未知/絶滅/換算/沿岸

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者さんの、本気で、絶対、栄養、絶対、吸収、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、観察しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, we take our patients' nutritional absorption very seriously. The medical team monitors it closely.
lines.style: Clear, measured opening. Professional warmth — not cold. Steady eye contact. A physician speaking to someone she respects, confident in the work being done.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 薬の、本気で、絶対、原料、絶対、貴院、絶対、徹底管理、絶対、されているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I've heard your hospital maintains rigorous standards for drug formulation sourcing.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity with a slight edge of self-consciousness. Asking because he actually wants to know, not to impress. Careful pronunciation on the technical terms.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。古い症例の、本気で、絶対、発掘、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've been working through some of our older case files — there's a lot we can learn from them.
lines.style: Factual, unhurried. A small note of professional satisfaction. She's mentioning something she cares about. No need to oversell it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本日の、本気で、絶対、天候、絶対、急変、絶対、貴院、絶対、患者さん、絶対、心配ですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: With the weather turning like this, I imagine it creates additional concerns for your patients.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Genuine concern, not performative. He's making a real observation, a little uncertain if it lands.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんの、本気で、絶対、未知、絶対、症状、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、慎重に診ております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: It does. Especially when we're dealing with unusual symptoms. The team needs to be very careful with their assessments.
lines.style: Quiet weight to the words. She's speaking from experience — she's seen how weather complicates diagnosis. Patient but not patronizing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 希少疾患の、本気で、絶対、絶滅、絶対、危機、絶対、貴院、絶対、研究されたんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I read that your hospital has been researching rare diseases, particularly those facing extinction-level mortality rates.
lines.style: Academic curiosity mixed with genuine respect. He's done some homework. Slightly formal phrasing because he's impressed and trying not to show it too much.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。薬剤量の、本気で、絶対、換算、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、慎重に行います、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. When we adjust medication dosing, especially for rare conditions, the calculations require exceptional precision from the team.
lines.style: Professional focus. A hint of the meticulous care this requires — she's not rushing through it. Steady, almost meditative delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 沿岸、本気で、絶対、地域の、絶対、医療体制、絶対、貴院、絶対、支援されているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I understand your hospital provides medical support to the surrounding coastal communities as well.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment, trailing into genuine interest. He's building a fuller picture of what she does. Slight rise at the end — opening a door, not closing it.
